optimizedDescription.value: Maps TS/TSX/JS/JSX to deterministic code-graph facts; filters anonymous array-data properties but preserves callable and named-object symbols.

optimizedContext.value:
# TypeScript language adapter

## Rules
- `TypeScriptLanguageAdapter`: `.ts`→`typescript`, `.tsx`→`tsx`, `.js`→`javascript`, `.jsx`→`jsx`; parse content once via registered Tree-sitter/ast-grep; return complete `FileAnalysisDraft`; no source reads or persisted AST.
- Emit deterministic symbols, imports, scoped bindings, calls, references, compact serializable parser state; parser runtime keepalive only indexing session.
- Extract functions; callable variables/arrows/HOF wrappers; classes; class/object methods, fields; prototype/static, namespace/member assignments; destructuring; exported variables; aliases, interfaces, enums. Shared broad `SymbolKind` never substitutes symbol-space/member form.
- Symbol construct range = full parser node; `selectionRange` = declared identifier; retain attached JSDoc/block/contiguous-line comments verbatim; omit invalid/rangeless candidates.
- Omit non-callable property when anonymous enclosing object crosses array boundary before supported named declaration; include direct/nested array records. Preserve scalar properties on named object declarations through parentheses, assertions, `as const`, `satisfies`; always preserve callable values/methods. Filtering never alters indexed source content; preserved properties keep parser ranges; analysis deterministic.
- Logical declaration space follows proven kind. Class/interface method logical owner derives parser containment then owner logical symbol, never parser ID/`SymbolNode.parentId`; distinct same-name owners remain distinct; top-level no owner; preserve proven member forms. Unsupported-owner method-like symbols remain location-backed, omitted logical-member facts.
- Extract static imports (named/default/namespace/type-only/side-effect/aliased), literal `import()`/`require()`, ESM/CJS exports, named/star re-exports; drop nonliteral dynamic loads. Public bindings preserve surface, exported name, space, known target, every re-export route; Pass 2 routes never collapse; relative candidates include extensions/index; package imports use known identities.
- Emit deterministic scope/import/alias/typed-param/constructor-property/field/return/type-RHS/`this`/construction facts. Emit `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE` only proven locally/import/receiver/indexed; caller = innermost callable; drop module-scope, ambiguous, unresolved, computed, runtime-only.
- Resolve class/interface `extends`, class `implements`, same-form proven member replacement: `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. Reference facts include child, ancestor/contract, relation, precedence, ordered provenance; separate alternate routes; terminate cycles. `hierarchy: true` only with supported evidence.
- Package identity: nearest bounded `package.json` `name`; bare/scoped package longest known prefix; filesystem search stops repo root. `buildContext: false`; no tsconfig inheritance/references/`baseUrl`/`paths`, conditions/conditional `exports`/`imports`.
- Advertise only emitted-fact capabilities. Parse failure, unsupported/incomplete semantics use coverage; no name-only guesses; all output/provenance deterministic.

## Constraints
- No project-code execution or implicit TypeScript compiler fallback.
- Runtime reflection, computed exports, monkey patching, unproven interprocedural value flow unsupported.
- TypeScript syntax logic stays adapter; generic resolution consumes shared facts only.
